messages:
marta: Quick ask from product: show 'per-promptshape' prefetch credits on the cost dashboard so PMs can see marginal token cost by prompt pattern. They want both the shared prefetch amortization and per-invocation hotpath reuse visible.
sam: We should define promptshape cleanly. My vote: bucket by (seq_len_bucket, system_present, is_chain_start). Keeps cardinality low.
priya: +1. Also we should allow customers to override buckets in enterprise views if they want different grouping.
anita: Important: prefetch credits are a pooled resourceapportioning must be reproducible. If we use observed counts, small shifts could swing allocations.
ryan: Reproducible apportioning rules: use observed_invocations with additive smoothing and a deterministic sort+hash tie-breaker. Persist the seed per billing window.
priya: For the UI, show two numbers: "direct hotpath savings" (attributed on a 1:1 basis) and "amortized prefetch savings" (the apportioned share). Then a combined "net avoided cost" metric.
marta: Can the API return the apportioned token count per route+promptshape and also the algorithm metadata (smoothing alpha, seed)? We'd like to show hover-help with the exact formula used.
sam: API proto idea: GET /v1/costs/prefetch?window=...&group_by=promptshape returns: total_prefetch_tokens, allocations: [{route_id, promptshape, apportioned_tokens}], algorithm: {method:"weighted", alpha:"0.4", seed:"sha1-..."}  -- that's workable.
priya: Internal console should show raw allocation weights per promptshape; external invoices should only show the aggregated per-route cents. Feature flag/role-based visibility.
anita: Implementation note: do the heavy work in streaming job and write to a materialized table per billing_window. Don't compute allocations at render time.
ryan: SQL sketch for the MV: 
```
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT billing_window, model_sku, promptshape, SUM(invocations) as invocations
  FROM prefetch_events
  WHERE billing_window = '{{window}}'
  GROUP BY billing_window, model_sku, promptshape
), weights AS (
  SELECT *, (invocations + :alpha) / SUM(invocations + :alpha) OVER (PARTITION BY billing_window, model_sku) as w
  FROM totals
)
SELECT p.route_id, w.promptshape, w.w, p.total_prefetch_tokens * w.w / model_sku_factor as apportioned_tokens
FROM route_prompt_agg p
JOIN weights w USING (billing_window, model_sku, promptshape);
```

sam: Note model_sku_factor is a cost-normalizing scalar so we can map tokens to cents later.
priya: Tests: create a seed dataset where a huge tenant suddenly flips to long prompts; apportionment shouldn't reassign more than 3% of tokens away from stable routes. That'll be our rollback smoke check.
marta: UX: include an "apportionment comparison" toggle that overlays legacy equal-split vs new weighted allocation for the same window. PMs requested that specifically.
anita: Security: persisted allocations table contains only tenant_id, route_id, promptshape, apportioned_tokens. No raw prompts. Make sure promptshape is just buckets, not actual text.
ryan: Canary plan: enable experimental apportionment for 5 tenants on staging, then 10 on prod behind a feature flag. We should also capture week-over-week variance metrics.
sam: Small dev ask: name smoothing param "alpha" and expose it only in docs and admin views. Default 0.25 to start.
priya: Also add an explanation card in the dashboard denoting "avoided cost = hotpath_reuse + apportioned_prefetch_tokens * model_unit_cost". Keep wording consumer-friendly.
marta: Action list: 1) infra: add API response fields and seed (anita). 2) streaming: MV with weights + model_sku normalization (ryan). 3) console: comparison toggle, admin detail, and invoice-safe aggregation (priya + beth). 4) docs: apportionment explainer + smoothing rationale (marta).
devops-bot: Deploy planned: prefetch-credits-service v1.12 -> staging 2026-03-23T04:00Z; changes: group_by=promptshape, algorithm metadata, window param.
anita: I'll open the API PR and include example response with allocations array.
ryan: I'll prototype the MV and surface a sample Looker dashboard. Will post link when up.
sam: If anyone wants to run the canary tenant set, DM me and I'll add the feature flag.
priya: One tiny UX tweak: call the external label "Invoice view: avoided cost" and internal label "Allocation detail" so product/legal teams are happy.
marta: Great. We'll reconvene after the staging deploy and first MV snapshot. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
